name: PDBTM_get_topology
description: Retrieve structure-derived transmembrane classification for one PDB entry from PDBTM: per-chain type (alpha-helical, beta-barrel, or not membrane-embedded) and transmembrane segment count, computed directly from coordinates. Example: pdb_id='2por' (porin) returns a 16-strand beta-barrel; pdb_id='1prc' (photosynthetic reaction centre) shows 5 TM helices each in the L and M subunits and 1 in H. Complements OPM_search_structures (geometry/energetics) and TopDB_get_topology (curated evidence).

topology_segments.description: The chain's topology as labelled residue ranges. num_tm_segments counts the transmembrane runs; these say where they are, and on 2por and 1prc the run count reproduces num_tm exactly

region.description: Region name from the entry's legend, e.g. 'Transmembrane Beta strand', 'Side1', 'Membrane Inside'

confidence.description: PDBTM's confidence classification for the assignment, e.g. 'curated'

start_residue.description: First PDB residue label in the run

end_residue.description: Last PDB residue label in the run

amino_acids.description: Three-letter residue types in the run

topology_segments_truncated.description: True when the chain has more than 200 segments

residue_count.description: Residues assigned a region on this chain

residues_by_region.description: Residue count per region name for this chain

regions.description: The region legend the per-residue assignment refers to; without it a site id means nothing

model_coordinates_url.description: The membrane-positioned coordinates (.trpdb) - the structure the classification was computed from

entry_url.description: The PDBTM page for this entry

includes_het_groups.description: Whether hetero groups are in the model

evidence_codes.description: How the assignment was made, as ECO terms

software_version.description: Version of the software that computed the assignment
